bug_semantics: llama-server use-after-free of ctx_server.vocab on six HTTP tokenization-family endpoints (/tokenize, /detokenize, /infill, /apply-template, /rerank, /anthropic/count_tokens) when --sleep-idle-seconds is enabled. Those handlers construct server_res_generator, which calls wait_until_no_sleep() and then drops mutex_tasks; they then tokenize or otherwise dereference ctx_server.vocab on the HTTP worker thread, bypassing the completion task queue. Concurrently the main loop can observe an empty queue, enter sleep, and run destroy() -> llama_init.reset(), which frees llama_model (and the embedded llama_vocab) without nulling the cached vocab pointer. The TOCTOU window after the awake check lets a worker finish using a dangling vocab pointer, causing crash or potential code execution via heap reclaim.
flaw_origin: Sleep-idle was added in squash-merged PR ggml-org/llama.cpp#18228 (tag b7492). Queue-level wait_until_no_sleep and a destroy() that did not free the model landed first; the UAF becomes real in member e6ab62c4a1af57fcba5c982ced53c2522b9517d1 ('make sure to free llama_init'), which first wrote llama_init.reset()/ctx=nullptr/model=nullptr in destroy() while leaving vocab live. Parent 44a5a26c32ec7d41706680a4d2ca1f268c9166a2 still only freed mtmd/slots/batch. Tokenize-family handlers already used ctx_server.vocab after wait_until_no_sleep at that parent. A later same-PR 'fix use-after-free' (105e2f3) only preserved metrics across resume and did not close this race.

The assigned GitHub repo only hosts Cyera patches; the vulnerable lines live in ggml-org/llama.cpp. Advisory floor b7492 is squash ddcb75dd8ac42dc23eb84f13bb17670fe9f2d49b of PR #18228. That squash is an aggregate, so it is not the BIC. Reconstructable members show destroy() without model free until e6ab62c4a1af57fcba5c982ced53c2522b9517d1, whose parent 44a5a26c32ec7d41706680a4d2ca1f268c9166a2 still lacks llama_init.reset while already exposing post_tokenize and the other listed handlers on ctx_server.vocab after wait_until_no_sleep. Direct parent-tree read confirms the free is absent before e6ab62c, so that commit is the smallest first-write of the flawed mechanism. unpatched.reason: Vendor closed the GHSA and public patch PR ggml-org/llama.cpp#24063 without merging. llama.cpp HEAD c841aeeb8bb2fe417038dadfa9b007cf1a9ef950 still has destroy() llama_init.reset() without vocab = nullptr and wait_until_no_sleep without an active-request refcount, so the tokenize-endpoint UAF remains reachable when --sleep-idle-seconds is set.

potential_fix.approach: In server_context_impl::destroy(), set vocab = nullptr after llama_init.reset(). Increment an atomic n_active_requests in wait_until_no_sleep() and decrement it from server_res_generator's destructor; refuse should_sleep() while n_active_requests != 0. On tokenize-family handlers, fail closed if ctx_server.vocab is null after wake.
potential_fix.rationale: That removes the dangling vocab pointer and closes the TOCTOU window so the main thread cannot free llama_model/vocab while HTTP workers still run /tokenize, /detokenize, /infill, /apply-template, /rerank, or /anthropic/count_tokens.
